reason_for_v2: v1 grouping unioned only each DTM's nearest-neighbour edge, which is not single linkage, and that edge could point at a scene outside the usable set. Re-running the graph over all 2346 polygon pairs at 10 km collapses the 69 usable scenes into 41 groups instead of 51, and merges SPARIM1/SPARIM2 (identical centre, 0 km) which v1 had split across two selected groups.

grouping.method: all-pairs polygon distance in a local azimuthal equidistant projection, sphere R=1737.4 km
grouping.overlap_note: 31 of the 34 sub-0.5 km pairs share real area (up to 112.7 km2, LICHTENBER2/LICHTENBER7) and all of them come from different stereo sources, so they are independent observations of the same ground: one group, and at most one scene per overlapping neighbour in the selection.

v1_to_v2_diff.shared_group_ids: 36 (the singletons, whose membership did not change)
v1_to_v2_diff.sparim: v1 split SPARIM1/SPARIM2; v2 groups SPARIM1..4 together and the overlap rule keeps one

selection.overlap_rule: inside a group, a scene is skipped if it overlaps an already selected scene by >1 km2
selection.order: sha256(group_id) ascending for groups, sha256(scene) ascending inside a group

skipped_scenes.reason: overlaps an already selected scene by >1 km2

selection.fallback_rule: If a selected scene fails a data gate below, record the gate, the measured value and the reason, then take the next group in rank order. Exclusions may only cite data quality, never a model result. At most 20 percent of groups may be replaced; beyond that the freeze is BLOCKED_NEW_HELDOUT.

data_gates_per_scene.coverage: single-acquisition L+R union over DTM valid pixels >= 0.95 (runbook target)
data_gates_per_scene.mosaic_scope: one acquisition only; a second acquisition is a separate stratum, never blended
data_gates_per_scene.registration: crater-centroid GCP consistent with the DTM terrain to 1-2 px (2-5 m); no <=1 px claim
data_gates_per_scene.grid: ortho grid must pass scripts/grid_consistency_p20.py exactly (nearest QA cube)
data_gates_per_scene.illumination: record SPICE solar azimuth/elevation per camera; spread guard 10 deg azimuth / 5 deg elevation
data_gates_per_scene.native_resolution: DTM post spacing <= 3 m, no interpolation-based claims
data_gates_per_scene.independence: footprint_disjoint and source_disjoint true; scene stays inside its group
data_gates_per_scene.radiometry: record scaling factor, NULL handling and saturation share; no DTM-derived layer as optical input

forbidden: running any model prediction or inspecting heldout risk labels before the manifest is hashed
relaxing the 0.95 coverage gate or the 10 km spacing rule inside this version
splicing a second acquisition into a mosaic to reach coverage
reporting an accuracy figure that depends on the selected scenes before they are frozen
selecting two scenes that overlap inside one group
using the nearest-neighbour grouping (scripts/audit_groups_p20.py) for any freeze decision
